item.title: The Biggest Pro-AI Super Pac Network Didn't Really Impact the Midterms
item.description: Leading the Future, backed by Silicon Valley’s biggest billionaires, had a war chest of $100 million and an aggressive stance against AI regulation. All of it didn’t add up to much on Tuesday night.

item.title: Hackers stole DreamHost customer files and inboxes during months-long attack
item.description: The web host said hackers exploited a vulnerability to access customer emails and files during a "deliberate attack."

item.title: Hacker steals millions by scamming high-stakes online poker games with this devious malware attack
item.description: Hundreds of online poker players may have lost millions after malware allegedly gave a hacker access to their computer screens during games.

item.title: Pangram expands its AI detection tools to video and images
item.description: The company behind the widely used tool for AI text is moving into more kinds of AI slop.

item.title: ‘Blade Runner 2099’ Shows the ‘Silver Linings’ of a Replicant Takeover
item.description: Showrunner Silka Luisa and star Hunter Schafer want their series, Blade Runner 2099, to show the benefits of a post-revolution world.

item.title: Gemini for Home now plugs into AT&T’s smart security system
item.description: AT&T's smart home security system now integrates with Gemini for Home. The company says its Connected Life system is the "first" home security product to integrate with Google Home Premium, enabling a bunch of Gemini-powered features that can summarize home events, search your video history, and more. With the update, Gemini for Home can provide […]...

item.title: Every historic win in the 2026 U.S. midterm elections
item.description: The 2026 midterms shocked many onlookers as a wave of Democratic firsts flipped seats and ushered a blue sweep across the country.

item.title: Google Is Forcing AI Overviews in Classrooms. Schools Are Searching for a Way Out
item.description: Google is tying up AI Overviews with traditional search, angering parents and educators who worry that easy, machine-generated answers are leaving kids less capable.

item.title: Xbox is testing two new controller options for Cloud Gaming
item.description: The Nano Controller is adopting a Google Stadia trick.

item.description: Et si la Terre n’avait jamais abrité la moindre forme de vie ? Pour explorer ce scénario vertigineux, des chercheurs ont créé une simulation informatique de notre planète privée de toute activité biologique, qu’ils ont fait évoluer sur plusieurs milliards d’années. item.title: Leak TruStream review: a gifted network audio player that just lacks a bit of dynamic headroom
item.description: For the TruStream, Leak has hidden a whole lot of cutting-edge digital audio functionality in what looks like a piece of audio equipment from the swinging sixties

item.title: This map shows just how big Democrats won the midterms
item.description: A vibe shift visualized. The 2026 election was a total political reset from 2024, with many states that voted for President Donald Trump last time swinging to the left and giving Democrats control of the next Congress. A pair of maps shows through arrows just how dramatic the change in just two years really was.

item.title: McDonald’s to add new value bundles next year
item.description: U.S. same-store sales fell 0.2% in the July-September period. McDonald’s plans to introduce new value-oriented meal bundles early next year after a disappointing third quarter that saw lower traffic at U.S. restaurants.

item.title: Knives Are Out in the White House
item.description: From top officials like Pete Hegseth to White House aides to right-wing pundits, the race is on to find someone besides Donald Trump to blame for the Republicans’ catastrophic losses.

item.title: Open source AI is booming. Hugging Face explains who profits.
item.description: Open source models are becoming more mainstream as enterprises, governments and startups alike rely on the promise of lower costs, more control, and more flexibility. But as increasingly capable models become more freely available, how do companies capture value? And with Chinese open models gaining ground, can American players keep up? On this episode of […]...

item.title: DuckDuckGo pitches itself to schools amid backlash over Google’s AI policy
item.description: DuckDuckGo is courting schools frustrated by Google's AI restrictions, pointing educators to its search engine and options to disable AI features.

item.title: SpaceX is snapping up hundreds of homes near its new flagship AI data center — but only if the owners agree to one incredible catch
item.description: SpaceX reportedly wants to purchase 418 homes near its Mississippi AI facilities, with homeowners facing conditions linked to an ongoing turbine noise lawsuit.

item.title: Hugging Face’s CEO Says His P(Doom) Is ‘Close to Zero’
item.description: “Most of the risk is actually created by a couple of players building behind closed doors,” Clément Delangue said of the need for open source AI.
